best_for: Windows users chasing heat, fan or power problems who want one free window listing every temperature, voltage and fan speed the hardware reports.

points.title: Reads the sensors your PC exposes
points.text: It shows temperatures, voltages, power, current, fan speeds, load and clocks for the CPU and GPU, motherboard sensor chips, memory modules with thermal sensors, and drives through S.M.A.R.T.

points.title: Laptop batteries too
points.text: It reads battery data, including the charge rate in watts, which helps when a laptop drains faster than it should.

points.title: Free, with a PRO upsell
points.text: HWMonitor is freeware for Windows x86 and x64. CPUID sells an extended PRO version, but the HWMonitor page does not spell out what PRO adds.

points.title: Setup or zip
points.text: Version 1.68 from 14 September 2026 comes as a setup or a zip, both carrying 32-bit and 64-bit builds. The installer listed here installs for the whole machine.

points.title: It watches, it does not control
points.text: HWMonitor displays readings. The page lists no fan control, alerts or overclocking features.

points.title: Older builds for odd hardware
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 26 versions, useful when a new release misreads a sensor on an older board.
